info.name: ALTR — Tag-based governance policy on Databricks Databricks Tag Policy API
Start application of a tag-based policy

items.docs:
When `policyAction` is `set`, an asynchronous Databricks job is launched to apply the given `policy` on all columns tagged with `tagName`.

When `policyAction` is set to `delete`, `policy` is ignored, and a Databricks job is launched to remove policy configured on tag `tagName`.

In either case, the status of the job can be tracked with the `GET` endpoint using the returned `id`.

info.name: Get status and logs of a tag-based policy application

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the tag-based policy application as provided in the `POST` response

items.docs:
Check status of an asynchronous application of a tag-based policy started in the `POST` endpoint.

Returns the status and, if available, a presigned S3 URL to the logs.
